canonical_project: Dubai Airports Modular Data Centre Complex (DXB)
notes: Huawei official press (2017-10 first modular deployment at DXB; 2018-03 double Tier III MDCC) confirms the Dubai Airports modular data centre complex - a mirrored Tier III pair at Dubai International, the first of its kind. DXB/Al Garhoud siting maps to Sector 2. No public MW capacity.
